inventory.item: Each ratio answers one question; same P/E can hide different stories (Co. X is a one-off example)
Four groups: growth, profitability, safety, cash and price; which Part teaches which
Peer comparison: same industry, size band, accounting basis
TCPL sales 25x Pahadi: not a peer of fictional firms
PEG = P/E / EPS growth (% points); Ramu 1.47~1.5, Pahadi 1.9, Masala 1.6
PEG limits: which growth, fade, capital needs, rebound, near-zero growth
Traffic-light thresholds are rules of thumb, differ by industry; D/E example
Dashboard lab with adjustable lines, edit-a-company, which-would-you-pick
Ratios contradict: low P/E vs weak cash and others; contradictions point to next reading
How to read a ratio sheet: basis, price date, definition, peers, blanks, trend; same label different numbers (ROCE 8.55/9.1/8.3, P/E 69.7/62.8, net cash 926/2,978)
TCPL growth: revenue +15.2%, owners' profit +20.6%, EPS +19.4%
TCPL net cash 926 (series def), interest cover 15.8, current ratio 1.57, cash cycle ~10 days
TCPL at 1,086.30: mcap 107,496; P/E 69.7; P/B 4.93; EV 107,971; EV/EBITDA 38.7; div yield 0.92%; FCF yield 1.84%; PEG 3.6
Story: strong cash and clean balance sheet; modest returns from goodwill; high multiple means market expects a lot; no verdict
